moat_against: Fiber overbuild + fixed wireless: internet customers fell 172k in Q2 2026, -515k YoY; revenue -1.7% YoY, fourth straight shrinking quarter
ROIC proxy only ~8.9-9.4% (2023-25) — thin spread over the cost of capital for a 7+ moat
Video in secular decline; broadband ARPU falling under retention promotions
Mobile is an MVNO on T-Mobile's network — the growth leg rides on a competitor's asset
Extreme leverage (net debt $94.3B pre-Cox) leaves no room to answer a price war
moat_for: Scaled local footprint — largest US cable operator after the Aug 2026 Cox close, ~70M homes passed (search-cited deal coverage)
Converged bundle: Spectrum Mobile grew to 12.5M lines (+406k in Q2 2026), raising switching friction
Operating margin expanded 17.5% (2020) to 23.6% (2025) on cost discipline despite flat revenue
DOCSIS 4.0 / network evolution to multi-gig symmetrical speeds defends the core product
moat_justification: Local cable footprint scale and converged broadband+mobile bundling still give pricing power and low churn, but fiber overbuilds and fixed wireless are taking subscribers outright, video is in secular decline, mobile rides on a rival's network (MVNO), and ROIC proxy has only run ~9% in 2023-25 — barely above the cost of capital, not wide-moat evidence.
name: Charter Communications, Inc.
one_liner: Eroding cable moat 4/10 on 39.6x levered OE — clears 15% only on the conservative median base (17.3% weighted, IV $130 vs $110) with a Tier C bear case; the TTM base would print S, so the verdict is base-dominated and sized to the bear end.
